semantic_contract.economic_sequence: market-wide opening panic -> forced selling/dislocation -> opening panic absorption -> improving internals -> observable repair confirmation -> trade after confirmation -> continuation outcome
semantic_contract.confirmation_trigger: market-wide repair score observed at a completed fixed checkpoint
semantic_contract.entry_time: open of the first continuous five-minute execution window after checkpoint, equal to the first minute after checkpoint

time_anchors.source_clock: immutable QD-004 completed one-minute bars on exact 241-row sessions; 09:45 close, 09:46 open, and 10:00 close must reconcile exactly to overlapping certified PIT-B five-minute windows

opening_panic.down_gap_breadth_5: fraction of opening-eligible board names with open/preclose-1 <= -0.05
opening_panic.open_median_return: cross-sectional median open/preclose-1; sign reversed for score
opening_panic.near_or_exact_lower_limit: 0 <= observed price - registered down_limit_price <= CNY 0.015, retaining the authoritative V1 exact/near tick convention
opening_panic.limit_stress_breadth: fraction of opening-eligible names near or at registered lower limit at open
opening_panic.score: equal mean of board/fold TRAIN empirical-CDF ranks of down_gap_breadth_5, negative open_median_return, and limit_stress_breadth
opening_panic.test_application: all component transforms and score thresholds frozen from own-board TRAIN

repair_features.median_price_repair: median checkpoint_price/open-1 among opening-eligible names with hard-valid checkpoint and entry windows
repair_features.panic_stock_reclaim_breadth: among checkpoint-observed names opening <=-5%, fraction checkpoint_price >= open*1.01; unavailable when denominator is zero
repair_features.limit_release: one minus still-near-lower-limit checkpoint fraction among opening-near-lower-limit checkpoint-observed names; unavailable when denominator zero
repair_features.breadth_improvement: fraction checkpoint_price > open among checkpoint-observed names
repair_features.score: equal mean of own-board/fold TRAIN empirical-CDF ranks; omit unavailable limit_release or panic-stock-reclaim component and retain equal weights over available components
repair_features.component_rank_history: all own-board TRAIN dates at the same checkpoint
repair_features.repair_threshold_history: own-board TRAIN panic sessions under the selected panic rule
repair_features.transparent_bins: TRAIN Q33/Q67 within each panic rule, diagnostic only

basket_outcomes.primary: equal-weight return across opening-eligible names with valid checkpoint/entry and corresponding action-safe outcome
basket_outcomes.entry: raw open of first five-minute window after checkpoint; 20 bp entry cost
basket_outcomes.missing_leg_policy: report coverage and exclude only the unavailable leg from that outcome aggregate; no signal or parameter depends on future leg availability
basket_outcomes.portfolio: one synthetic board basket per sleeve, full available sleeve NAV, no leverage; skip signal while prior same-board basket remains active
basket_outcomes.marking: entry-day checkpoint-to-close basket mark; terminal outcome on frozen exit date; carry the last basket mark between dates when a first-legal-open leg delays the synthetic terminal date
basket_outcomes.year_boundary: do not admit a basket whose frozen terminal date is after replay end

adapter_amendment.timing: before any valid repair feature, basket outcome, search row, or performance result existed
adapter_amendment.failed_attempt: certified execution_5m contains only windows 0 through 5 ending at 10:00, so later checkpoints, next-minute entries, and 15:00 close were all unavailable and the attempted state panel had zero valid minute observations
adapter_amendment.replacement: read exact bars from the already frozen immutable QD-004 annual files, require exactly 241 unique completed minute timestamps per security/session, and reconcile every overlapping early value to PIT-B execution_5m

selection.neighborhood: top five TRAIN configurations replayed unchanged next year

counterfactuals.PANIC_ONLY: same panic rule, checkpoint, exit and opening-state transforms; remove only repair threshold
counterfactuals.REPAIR_WITHOUT_SEVERE_PANIC: same checkpoint and repair threshold applied to dates below the champion panic threshold; diagnostic only
